book.name: Tayusima
book.title: Tsiyatsis tayusima anu Móysisarini Israelchichee waneero, tsiyatsis tayusirangiya

content.text: Siysa Israelchichis ichingarus kaapaniri nee mazinangtsa.
Na nuw tsiyatkachuri, sin sinaku zapan paratzatariya.
Púranas tamapari ashiru pzeezakchu ichingarumun chirichir kachachtachiya,
Ichingarumun mashar xuwattaru uru amb ashtachiya, nuw siyaam tsiyatkachurina.
Ashiri na nuw Apanllimun Taarashipanimun sur tsiyatkachuri siysa mazinangtsa.
Watam Apanll iyaa urutamari ichingaru zar ksutku taakiya. Ichingaru yuw waana ashirangu an wanasirinandaricha.
Ichingaroo tputs minumtaatsiripaz ashiru chinaku taakiya;
Ashirucha, yuwaa tputs amb ashkana anoo Apanll ¿antaati Nuw ipartana, tácheeja? ndambaree, atiya.
Apanlltaa siyaa tinarangunts, ashiritaa siysa waa kuk kapeetaksa.
Ashiriya, yuwamand siyaam Apanll aship istayaranllu anumand
Siyashuch pakchiyam nda wanasir chinamaam yasaksa,
nduntaatiya ashiru, siy maachiritaatsis kizpur wachina, pachireewatsis saanpata mashangtsa.
Sirútama Aparich waamari kasiru, tputsee tsapuranasshuchee ipuseeru,
Apanll uru wasina iyaa Israelchicheetsini waama tiptsir ipusarangiya.
Ashiri anchicheetssinaya ashiru, Nuwpari tputsirina, tárangiya Apanlli.
Tputs wipaa kizaa kizpur chinaku tamatarparee ashiru,
Kpurangamash maachi yungan wipaa purangamaam tayaspatapi átu,
Yusur waantatam, Naringapi átu, ushimun wipaa chipata sheeru,
Apanll Taarashipan waana siyaa wanasir ksutarangiya.
Itaru, Apanll wamari siyaa amb ashiru ichingarootsis wanasir ksutarangiya.
Anush tsapuranas ichingaru maachi katungats wanus wanasirimshinand taariya.
Wakararis pzapaneekchus, mimiree yáyarus, waakus taatssa.
Kaaparaatstam, opeejaatstam karupana wanuts katungkus kis taatssa.
Chinuz Basanamand tsap kizpureew wanasireew kuschu anootstam katungatssa.
Tatsumartamtis tirikuris kizpur wanasir kxunkachu, wanusee pusatssa.
wakunguree vinoom yáyarus, waakus, kizpur wanasir taatssa.

Itaru, siy anush tsap taakchus, nutsis kapunguyarus, yunganteerus, mangis kis Apanllee ngatkus, wakar tamatarparee ashirus, Apanllee kata, kata ashikpaz ashitssa. ¡Maya! Kizpur yungantkachus, wakar ashirus nutsis kawapshishtarus taatssa.
Apanlltaa siyaa tinarangu, tapachindarangitaa, ashiritaa siysa Apanllee niyratssa.
Siysa apanllputsee mantsirimshee ungirtakus, Apanllsha anumand kapung tsiyantakiya. Watam siyaa kizpur pachindku, Nuwaatsimari chinangasindama, atuwa, anumand siyaa wanichapantsa.
Wakarareetsis pachayarus, muchkus, yashingootsimari ungirtakus taatssa.
¿Nee apanllputsee antaati iy zitaminarani sirútama patarazinllinaja? táyarus,
Nuw siyaa Israelchicheetsis atashina: Aparich waana siyaam taarasheemis wayarangitaa,
itaru siysa Apanllee kuk izuuru kasachpasa.
siyaa mangutarishti arapeetari napchima, Ashkachuri, ¿mayaja siyash tushiych? pangpani.
Siy nllur mang' ndunari tamatarparee ashiris anoo ¿tamayareezich? ¿mangich tateechich? Pinascha.
Siysa mangishis piyari chinarangus, In watanacha iy Apanllirini, tárangus, apanllputseetssha ungirtarangis anumand
Ashiriya, nllitaritaatssha tputs yuw nda nuwaa yasarana anootssha nuwaama tputsireemi ipuschina. Amb ashkachuri,
Nuw kizpur tsiyani musákuri, mangishi sumas tamapari ashiru muchkiya.
An sumas tirookchuri, ashpari tsapoo, yasinawaatstam ichingaroo muchchiya.
Ashiriya, siyaam ichingaroomis kiyung yachamaam waneeshish zanganchintspa.
Nuw tsiyani musákchuri, wasapaatspaz ashiru siyaam tiyanchintspa.
Marizimun tsipatssa. Kurapamuntam wanguytakus, tsipatssa. Tsutasheetstam tsipatsimash zanganchitamana.
Kundararshitis sundarureetsis pachakchusin, ngootsish tamutamuru anootsimsha pangatssa.
Yap nda chinaris amb pangishitis pshtuyarusin, siyaa pachachinllinaya.
Siyaa arap zangankachuri, saani arap pseertarus, ambiri pastatssa.
Ashkachuri, ndusha nuw siyaa ayamtaati chinachintsa.
kundararshapsa nuwaa mantsir stachinllinaya, atutana, Nuw siyaa, Watsta, tárangina.
Iyamaricha kasirangini; iy watam kizpuriniwa, ashirupariniya.
Uw ¿tamaycheeja yuwaa iyamari kasirani anootsee? táchpasinaya kundararis nuwaatsiya.
Ashirucha, nuw siyaa izuurina nda kapeetamaam zandkina, Apanll mang amb tárangiya siyaatsi.
¿Tamasha Israelchichis nda kitsis mazinaksa? ¿Tamasha nda mangoonaksa?
Papcha. Apanll iyaa kizpur waneeruneepa, táchinaapsa.
Na mazinantsa, Sirú ¿tamarinaa siy minumtaatis sundaris minumtaa milo kundarareetsis kasirangsa?
Kundararini yasaksincha, watam Apanll waana tiptseereem istakuwa.
Watam iy kundararini taarash kizpur yutaritssincha.
Sirútama tamaru tputs Sodomshuch misha Gomorshuchtam taarangana ambitam ashirusin taakanaya.
makpaz wasun ashiru anpa tputsee tayutaritkiya.
anush nuwshat siyamand tistakachuri, kundarareetsis wanichima.
Amb ashkachuri, uwshtisin tsapush ashparitin paraat ashtachinllinaya.
Yuwash siyashuch kurakaris ndunareekchu, sundaruritamtis ndunareekchu,
Ashiri siy nuwaa kuki mazinangtsa, Nuw minumaritana Apanlli.
Nuwaana tputsee, tsipachpa tákchuri, tputs tsipakanaya.
Waani in tputs taachpa, tákchuri, tputs urutamari wachinayaru taakiya.
Nuwaana, tputsee in kiyung kachiyachpa, tákchuri, tputssha anuritam kiyung kachiykiya.
Mishat, tputs kas yutakchu, anoom nuwaantatam yarkina.
Nuw urutari sirútamasari taaranguri, ashiritam urutamaritam taachina.
Ashiriya, mchitareetsi kurakurtaru anoo yáyaruri, wanasir iwitseeruri,
anpat siyaa kundararis ashparita tpachingayaruri kasachima.
Yuwamand nuwaa kapung natsakana anumand nuwsha tpachingachima.
Mchitarpashti ichingaroo tputs much turuyaruri, kasachina.
putamawaatstam kayung, kurakawaatstam kayung, pachat, pachat ashtachina,
yuwaa sirú kundartarangis anoo ichingaroo kiyung yachachima.
Ashiriya, siynaa ichingarus tsapurnasshuchis Apanllchichis washunand Israelchichpat mangis ksangtsa.
Yuwamand iy kundararini iyachchee tputs pacharangana anumand
ashparita chingayaruri kasachima, watam Apanll waana atuwa.
Amb ashkachu, ichingaroo tputs yutaritshishpanee ashpari kachingeeru,
wanasirinandsha Israelash tsap taachinllinaya, Apanll átcha,

content: Móysisi tárangiya. Ashiriya, na kamaneena yuwaa Móysis yaseesshee tayaspatarangu anootsi.
Ashiriya, na kamanchintspa yuwaatssha Móysis yaseesshis iwatspayaru, minootssha Israelchichee waneerangu anootsi
Ashiriya, Móysis Josueypat, Nomarinpatini wip ipuneersin, washunand yuwash Israelchich ashpartin tputs shaneerana anush yaseesshee ashchiri natstaranganaya.
Ashiriya, na in zar tsiyatssee Apanllee kuk ichingarus mazinayarus, mangiptis chinangtsa. Ipareetstamtis tayaspatangtsa. Nee tsiyatsis wanasirimshee, Apanllee kamachtamarini urutamarisha payungtsa.

Mangutaritis iwaziri mazinakus, ¿ashinooja mangoonchis? Kitsiptis izuuru mazinangtsa. An Apanll kamachtamarini siyaam taarashishcha. Anoo tsiyatsis payukinaareesa ashiru, Kanaanash tsap urutamaripa zapan masach taatssa, yuwash Apanll siyaam Ortaga arachich panachintspa tárangu ambiya, Móysis Israelchichee tárangiya. Ashiriya, na kamaneena yuwaa Móysis Israelchichee yuwamunarisha iwatspakamchu, waneerangu anootsi.

footnotes.text: Romshucheema 12.19; Utaáshucheema 10.30 tsiyatsis nipta tatsamooru taaritamta.
Yuwaa nish átu anootstam Romshucheema 15.10 tayusima kamankiya.
Apanll wanichu anu 19.2 tsiyatsis nipta tatsamooru taaritamta.
